changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE email_schedule DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS email_schedule_report_type_check;

changeSet.author: josh

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_schedule WHERE report_type IS NOT NULL AND report_type::text NOT IN ( 'DASHBOARD_STATISTICS', 'DISCOUNTS_OFFERS', 'DISCOUNTS_PROMOTIONS', 'ITEMIZED_SALES', 'TABLE_WISE_SALES', 'PAYMENT_TYPES_BREAKDOWN', 'DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY', 'TRANSACTIONS', 'ORDERS', 'SALES', 'SALES_AND_REVENUE', 'PAYMENT_AND_FINANCIAL', 'MENU_PERFORMANCE', 'EMPLOYEE_PERFORMANCE' )

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE email_schedule ADD CONSTRAINT email_schedule_report_type_check CHECK (report_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[ 'DASHBOARD_STATISTICS'::character varying, 'DISCOUNTS_OFFERS'::character varying, 'DISCOUNTS_PROMOTIONS'::character varying, 'ITEMIZED_SALES'::character varying, 'TABLE_WISE_SALES'::character varying, 'PAYMENT_TYPES_BREAKDOWN'::character varying, 'DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY'::character varying, 'TRANSACTIONS'::character varying, 'ORDERS'::character varying, 'SALES'::character varying, 'SALES_AND_REVENUE'::character varying, 'PAYMENT_AND_FINANCIAL'::character varying, 'MENU_PERFORMANCE'::character varying, 'EMPLOYEE_PERFORMANCE'::character varying ]::text[]));
